params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of records to return.

params.name: cursor
params.description: Opaque cursor returned by the previous page. Omit for the first page.

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort by a supported field. Prefix with `-` for descending order.

params.name: email
params.description: Filter by an exact email address.

params.name: name
params.description: Filter Contacts by a partial, case-insensitive person name match.

params.name: account_id
params.description: Opaque Account ID with the `account_` prefix.

params.name: created_after
params.description: Return only records created after this ISO 8601 timestamp.

params.name: created_before
params.description: Return only records created before this ISO 8601 timestamp.

params.name: updated_after
params.description: Return only records updated after this ISO 8601 timestamp.

params.name: updated_before
params.description: Return only records updated before this ISO 8601 timestamp.

params.name: fields
params.description: Choose which public fields appear in each list record. Omit or pass a blank value for the default list fields, use `*` alone for every public detail field, or pass comma-separated names.

items.docs: Return a paginated list of Contacts. Supports filtering by `email`, `name`, `account_id`, and created/updated timestamps. Sort supports `created_at` or `-created_at`; pagination uses `limit` and `cursor`. Contacts that have been merged into another Contact are excluded. Use `fields` to choose which public Contact fields appear in each record.
Create a new person Contact, optionally linked to an Account via `account_id`. Returns the full Contact detail payload including the generated `con_` ID.

params.name: contact_id
params.description: Opaque Contact ID with the `contact_` prefix.

items.docs: Return a single Contact by its `con_` ID. If the requested Contact was merged into another, responds with `301` and a `Location` header pointing to the survivor Contact's canonical URL.

params.name: contact_id
params.description: Opaque Contact ID with the `contact_` prefix.

items.docs: Partially update a Contact by ID. Omitted fields are left untouched; `null` clears nullable fields. Returns `410 gone` if the Contact was merged into another and can no longer be mutated directly.

params.name: contact_id
params.description: Opaque Contact ID with the `contact_` prefix.

items.docs: Delete a Contact by ID. Returns `410 gone` if the Contact was merged into another — merged Contacts cannot be deleted directly.
